name: render_verify_custom_domain
description: Ask Render to re-check a custom domain's DNS configuration (HTTP POST, no body) — returns 202 Accepted. Call this after the user has created the required DNS record, to trigger verification. Render also verifies automatically after a domain is added, so you don't strictly need this on first setup; it's for re-checking after a later DNS change. To read the result, re-GET the domain with render_get_custom_domain and inspect `verificationStatus`. Requires `serviceId` and `customDomainIdOrName`.

customDomainIdOrName.description: The custom domain's id or its domain name.
